Leakage_Source: Exact nucleotide sequence reused across constructs
Scientific_Problem: Same sequence may appear with different conjugation, chemistry, or exposure.
Detection_Rule: Match normalized Sequence_5to3; group all exact matches.
Required_Action: Use Exact_Sequence_Group as an outer split group.
Model_Impact: Prevents parent/derivative leakage and inflated sequence performance.

Scientific_Problem: Volanesorsen/olezarsen and inotersen/eplontersen share nucleotide sequences but differ in context.
Required_Action: Keep each pair together in sequence-only partitions; analyze within treatment-aware lane.

Scientific_Problem: Alternating-AC length and LNA variants are not independent.
Required_Action: Keep scaffold relatives together in outer validation.

Scientific_Problem: Multiple rows for one oligo are correlated observations.
Required_Action: Oscar must create experiment_group_id and subject/donor_group_id where available.

Scientific_Problem: Assay and laboratory signatures can dominate model performance.
Required_Action: Report LOPO performance separately from random/internal validation.

Scientific_Problem: Pooled dose bands cannot be assigned back to individual sequences.
Required_Action: Exclude pooled rows from sequence-level labels; retain descriptive baseline.

Scientific_Problem: Same compound may appear in both clinical and mechanistic tables.
Detection_Rule: Link by Sequence_Record_ID but keep outcome domains separate.
Required_Action: Do not allow clinical labels to leak into ex vivo target construction or vice versa.
Model_Impact: Supports hierarchical analysis without circular labels.

Scientific_Problem: Filename-based identity can create false provenance and duplicates.
Required_Action: Train only from verified actual content and recovery records.

Scientific_Problem: Absence of reported thrombocytopenia can be mistaken for a negative label.
Required_Action: No sequence-level clinical negative unless all gates pass.
Scientist_Gate: FAIL if any inferred negative is used.
